Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the demo today — great questions and really clear use case notes on cost-sensitivity for high-frequency inference. Quick recap and next steps re: procurement so your finance team can evaluate the purchase path (PO vs card) and vendor onboarding timeline: 

- Attached: Redwood vendor packet (procurement intake checklist, vendor form, sample SOW and standard payment terms). Please share with your procurement lead.
- We need a completed W-9 (for US entities) or W-8BEN (for international) + banking details for ACH/wire setup. I attached a W-9 request template to make this easier.
- Preferred commerce path: you mentioned earlier that Stark normally issues POs for platform vendors; if procurement prefers card we can accommodate that too — we just need to know which path to surface in the contract and to confirm invoice cadence.
- Vendor portal: we can either onboard you to our vendor portal for recurring invoices (faster for POs) or bill via Stripe/credit card for immediate trials. Let me know preference.
- Next call: propose Tue 11/16 10am PT for procurement + finance. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and include Dev (our finance lead).

Attachments: redwood_vendor_packet_2027.pdf (intake checklist + vendor form), W-9_request_template.pdf

Thanks — happy to walk procurement through the packet on the call.

Best,

Hi Rachel / Stark procurement —

Thanks for the quick reply and for confirming PO as the preferred initial path. A few finance notes to keep the onboarding smooth: 

- We can onboard you to our vendor portal (recommended) which supports PO-based invoices and Net30/Net60 terms. Portal onboarding typically takes 3–5 business days after we receive the completed vendor form and Redwood’s W-9.
- I attached a filled Redwood W-9 for your records (redwood_w9_signed_2027.pdf). If procurement needs a signed scanned copy via DocuSign, I can send that link.
- Bank details: we do not email full account numbers. For ACH/wire setup we provide a secure vendor bank setup form via DocuSign — please sign that and we’ll supply the wiring instructions securely.
- Required fields on your side: legal entity name, remit-to address, PO contact name/email, and billing email. Once we have those we’ll set up the account and route invoices to your portal.

DocuSign link to secure bank form (expires in 7 days): https://docusign.com/complete/abc123
HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4598

Happy to jump on the Tue call to walk procurement through the portal and answer any compliance questions.

Cheers,
